sections.label: Public housing engagement exercise
sections.summary: Over 30,000 Singaporeans were engaged through the Long-Term Plan Review and Forward Singapore to understand their views on a refreshed social compact for public housing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Through the Long-Term Plan Review and the Forward Singapore exercise, we engaged over 30,000 Singaporeans to understand their values, hopes, and concerns for the future, including what a refreshed social compact for public housing should look like.

sections.label: Home completions and ageing
sections.summary: Almost 40,000 homes will be completed in 2023 and close to 100,000 by 2025, with eight in 10 Singaporean households in HDB flats and nearly one in four Singaporeans aged 65 and older by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Across the Housing and Development Board (HDB)’s Build-To-Order programme and private residential developments, there will be almost 40,000 home completions in 2023, and close to 100,000 by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Our public housing programme has enabled eight in 10 Singaporean households to live in HDB flats today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Nearly one in four Singaporeans will be 65 years and older by 2030.

sections.label: Refreshed housing social compact
sections.summary: The social compact on housing will be refreshed so housing stays affordable and accessible and estates remain inclusive, cohesive and sustainable, helping young married couples and families with children buy their first home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Many non-mature estates have also become much more well-developed over time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will refresh our social compact on housing, so that housing continues to be affordable and accessible, and our estates remain inclusive, cohesive and sustainable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will help young married couples and families with children buy their very first home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: (b)	We will keep public housing inclusive, including in our prime areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will continue to launch flats under the Prime Location Public Housing model.

sections.label: Firms, manpower and building emissions
sections.summary: Stronger firms with deeper capabilities will be supported, reliance on foreign manpower reduced, regulatory processes streamlined, and efforts ramped up to reduce building emissions towards net zero by 2050.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will support the growth of stronger firms with deeper capabilities, reduce our reliance on foreign manpower, and streamline regulatory processes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will also ramp up efforts to reduce building emissions as we move towards our national climate target of net zero emissions by 2050.
